name: Build Farms & Roads
text: Build roads. Grow more food.
hint: It costs gold now. You get more food later.
ko: 지금 금고를 쓰고, 다음 2년 동안 생산이 늘어요.

name: Raise Taxes
text: People pay you more gold.
hint: You get gold. People are sad.
ko: 금고가 늘지만 행복이 줄어요.

name: Cut Taxes
text: People pay you less gold.
hint: People are happy. You get less gold.
ko: 행복이 늘지만 금고가 줄어요.

name: Open Trade
text: Trade with other lands.
hint: You get more goods.
ko: 물건이 늘고, 다른 나라의 영향을 더 받아요.

name: Close the Gates
text: No one comes in or out.
hint: You get fewer goods. Things cost more.
ko: 수입이 끊겨 물건이 줄고 값이 올라요.

name: Go to War
text: Send the army to fight.
hint: War costs a lot. You may win gold.
ko: 큰 비용이 들고, 이기면 금·은을 얻어요 (확률).

name: Borrow Money
text: Get gold now. Pay it back later.
hint: You get gold now. You must pay back more.
ko: 지금 금고가 늘지만 매년 이자를 내요.

name: Make a Little Money
text: Make a little more money.
hint: Bread may cost a bit more.
ko: 통화량이 조금 늘어요.

name: Make Lots of Money
text: Make lots and lots of money!
hint: You get gold fast. Bread may cost a lot more!
ko: 통화량이 크게 늘어요. 금고도 늘지만 물가가 위험해요.

name: Take Money Back
text: Take some money away.
hint: There is less money. Bread may cost less.
ko: 통화량이 줄어요.

name: Raise Interest
text: It costs more to borrow money.
hint: There is less money. There are fewer jobs.
ko: 금리를 올려요. 돈과 일자리가 줄어요.

name: Lower Interest
text: It costs less to borrow money.
hint: There is more money. There are more jobs.
ko: 금리를 내려요. 돈과 일자리가 늘어요.

name: Keep It Steady
text: Do not change a thing.
hint: Nothing changes. People like that.
ko: 변화 없음. 예측 가능해서 신뢰가 조금 올라요.

name: Back It with Gold
text: Keep gold safe for your money.
hint: People trust you more. You cannot make lots of money.
ko: 보유고로 돈을 보증해요. 신뢰가 오르고 통화량 증가가 제한돼요.

name: Less Silver in Coins
text: Put less silver in each coin.
hint: You get more coins. People may find out!
ko: 동전 수와 금고가 늘지만 2년 뒤 발각되면 신뢰가 크게 떨어져요.

name: Treasure Ships
text: Big ships bring silver home.
hint: You get lots of silver. Goods stay the same.
ko: 금·은과 통화량이 늘지만 생산은 그대로라 물가가 급등해요.

name: Paper Only!
text: No more coins. Use paper money!
hint: Paper is easy to make. Do not make too much!
ko: 지폐만 쓰게 해요. 인쇄가 쉬워져 남발 위험이 커져요.

name: Pay Taxes in Silver
text: People must pay you in silver.
hint: You get more gold each year. You need more silver.
ko: 금고가 안정되지만 은이 끊기면 디플레이션 위험이 2배예요.

name: Big 100-Coin
text: Make one coin as big as 100.
hint: You get gold fast. People do not trust it.
ko: 당백전. 통화량·금고가 늘지만 신뢰가 떨어지고 물가가 급등해요.

name: Make More Good Coins
text: Make more good coins.
hint: There are more coins. Shops can sell again.
ko: 상평통보를 더 만들어 전황(동전 부족)을 풀어요.

name: Let Go of Gold
text: Your money does not need gold now.
hint: You can make more money. People must trust you.
ko: 금본위를 떠나요. 통화량이 자유로워지지만 신뢰는 정책에 달려요.

name: Buy Bitcoin
text: Buy Bitcoin with your gold.
hint: It can go way up. It can go way down.
ko: 금고로 비트코인을 사요. 가치가 매년 크게 흔들려요. 두 번째에는 팔아요.
